solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadesh Darshan 2.0 - Theme-based tourism circuits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Swadesh Darshan 2.0** is an upgraded version of the Swadesh Darshan Scheme, focusing on sustainable and theme-based tourism circuits.
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Tourism, it aims to enhance tourism infrastructure and create employment opportunities in tourism-focused areas.
 
• The scheme prioritizes the development of circuits based on themes such as cultural heritage, ecotourism, adventure, and wellness tourism.
 
• It aligns with the vision of promoting responsible tourism, ensuring environmental sustainability and socio-economic benefits to local communities.
 
• Funding is provided for infrastructure development, capacity building, and marketing under this initiative to bolster India's tourism sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadesh Darshan Scheme (Original Version)**

 
 
• Launched in 2014-15, the original scheme aimed at developing theme-based tourist circuits across India.
 
• Some of the circuits include Buddhist Circuit, Himalayan Circuit, Coastal Circuit, and Tribal Circuit.
 
• It focused on integrated development of tourism infrastructure in specific destinations.
 
 
 
• **Incredible India Campaign**
 
 
• A flagship campaign by the Ministry of Tourism to promote India's rich cultural heritage globally.
 
• It emphasizes India's diversity, historical landmarks, and unique experiences for international tourists.
 
 
 
• **National Tourism Policy 2022**
 
 
• Aims to position India as a global tourism hub and strengthen domestic tourism.
 
• Focuses on sustainable tourism, digitalization, and supporting local businesses in the tourism sector.
 
 
 
• **Eco-Tourism in India**
 
 
• Promotes responsible travel to natural areas, conserving the environment and improving the well-being of locals.
 
• Popular destinations include Kaziranga National Park, Sundarbans, and Silent Valley National Park.
